## Detailed Project Portfolio

### 1. ServerTrack (fixedv6)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/yaratul2005/fixedv6
- **Type**: Open-Source Privacy Tracking Gateway
- **Tech Stack**: PHP, WooCommerce CAPI, WebKit ITP Bypass, Edge Header Rewriting
- **Summary**: Converts self-hosted CMS deployments into first-party Conversion API data gateways, bypassing Safari WebKit ITP and ad-blockers at the server edge with 99.8% capture efficiency.

### 2. WirePhoenix PHP Library
- **Repository**: https://github.com/yaratul2005/WirePhoenix
- **Type**: Custom PHP Socket & IPC Library
- **Tech Stack**: PHP 8.x, Unix Domain Sockets, Binary/Protocol Headers, IPC Transports
- **Summary**: High-performance PHP library for low-latency inter-process communication over Unix domain sockets with custom protocol flows.

## Academic Research Paper
- **Title**: Decentralized Edge Routing: Transforming Content Management Systems into First-Party Privacy-Preserving Conversion Gateways
- **Author**: Yaser Ahmmed Ratul
- **URL**: https://yaratul.com/research
- **Abstract**: Examines server-side attribution mechanisms against client-side blocking frameworks (WebKit ITP). Demonstrates a 99.8% conversion capture rate over a 30-day trial using ServerTrack edge nodes with zero added server infrastructure cost.
